test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per India Census 2011, which of the following states has the least growth of population in percentage terms between 2001 to 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The population of **Himachal Pradesh** grew by **12.94%** during the 2001-11 census while Punjab, Haryana, and Uttarakhand respectively 13.89%, 19.90%, and 18.81%.
 
• The total population of Himachal Pradesh was** ****6,864,602** according to the 2011 Census and the literacy rate was **82.80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some important 2011 census data**__

 
 
• States with highest growth rate:-
 
 
• Meghalaya - 27.9 %
 
• Arunachal Pradesh - 26%
 
 
 
• States with Lowest growth rate:-
 
 
• Nagaland - **-0.58 %.**
 
 
 
• State with highest literacy rate: -
 
 
• Kerala - 94%
 
• Mizoram - 91.3%
 
 
 
• Least Populated state- **Sikkim:- 6.1 lakh**
 
• Least populated UT:- **Laksyadweep - 64,473**
 
 
 
• The population of India grew by **17.7% during 2001 - 11.**
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** is the **lowest population density.**
 
• The highest population state is** Uttar Pradesh.** (199,812,341)
 
• Kerala has the highest sex ratio in the states category.
 
• 31.165 percent of the total population can be categorized as urban.
 
• The Goa state is the most urbanized state with 62.17% of the population living in urban areas.
 
• **Nagaland** is the only state to record **negative growth** in population in the country.
 
• For the 2011 Indian Census, **C M Chandramauli was the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India.**
